run_f_gold: run f_gold with an integer n to compute the sum of n divided by each b from 1 to n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in test harness with 10 parameter sets
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function which uses divisor-block optimization to count pairs efficiently
review_f_gold: review the f_gold algorithm that iterates over divisor blocks to compute the answer in O(sqrt(n)) time
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use integer division instead of float division for correct results
